newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gold closes slightly firmer at day's high in HK.
newsitem.headline: Gold closes slightly firmer at day's high in HK.

text.p: Hong Kong gold closed slightly firmer at the day's high on Friday after a day of slow, two-way trading, dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$345.70/346.20 an ounce against New York's US$345.50/346.20 close on Thursday.

"The local market has been very quiet with small amounts of shortcovering and profit-taking interest," said a dealer at an international metals house. "The price of gold stayed within a 60-cent range all day."
Another dealer said the immediate trend was uncertain.

"I think gold will stay range-bound, with support at US$340 and resistance at US$350," the dealer said. "Participants are cautiously watching the platinum and palladium price moves in the short term."
Local gold ended HK$2 lower at HK$3,197 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society dropped to -4.50 from its previous fix at nil.
Hong Kong close - US$345.70/346.20 New York close - US$345.50/346.00
